scope.summary: Implement the native data-driven graphics surface: typed StudioVariable bindings on document fields (layer visibility, pixel/placed-asset replacement, text-string replacement) REUSING the design-system StudioVariable/StudioVariableCollection primitives (14.10) - no automation-only variable type; dataset binding (rows entered manually or imported from delimited text/CSV/XML); single-row preview; batch expansion (one output document/asset per row) on the batch runner inheriting its receipting/quiet-law/promotion.
acceptance_criteria: data-driven binding + dataset import + row preview + batch expansion; reuses StudioVariable
proof_targets: variable-bind + CSV dataset + row-preview + batch-expansion test
expected_tests: live: bind visibility/pixel/text variables + import CSV dataset + preview a row
live: batch expansion generates one asset per row on the batch runner
test: reuses StudioVariable primitive (no forked type)

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Data-driven graphics & data merge

risk_if_missed: No data-merge; or a separate automation-only variable type forks the design-system primitive.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
